sources.title: neonforestmist/Clover-Image-Tiny-Inpaint · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Clover Image Tiny Inpaint is a compact, context-aware inpainting model for the SD 1.4-class 512×512 architecture. Paint the region to replace in white; black pixels are preserved. This v2 checkpoint was selected from bounded teacher-distillation sweeps for semantic prompt following, reconstruction, and clean mask-edge blending.

sources.title: neonforestmist/Clover-Image-Tiny-Inpaint-CoreML · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Clover Image Tiny Inpaint — Core ML Compiled Core ML resources for the v2 SD 1.4-class Clover Image Tiny inpainting model. The optional download contains 1,671,581,989 bytes: approximately 1,672 MB (1.56 GiB). It is installed separately from Regular Clover.
